title: Banner-survival leg of the new toast pin never reads the banner's z-index — only the toast's literal is asserted
evidence: Test doc comment: "/// banner (2147483000). Position AND banner survival are pinned through the demo's real view path" — but the assertions are only: `html |> string.contains("fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001]") |> should.be_true` and `html |> string.contains("fixed bottom-4 right-4") |> should.be_false`. The banner side lives outside the Lustre view in server/priv/static/consent.js:393: `"position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483000;" +` — grep across client/test, server/test and scripts shows no test reads that value.
detail: The #615 guarantee is an inequality (toast z 2147483001 > banner z 2147483000). If consent.js's z-index is ever raised above the toast's, every pin stays green while toasts render behind the banner. Currently correct at runtime; the pin bites only one side.
recommended_fix: Add a pin covering the banner leg, e.g. a server test or lint asserting consent.js keeps z-index:2147483000 (or a shared constant both sides reference).

title: docs_processed pin is tautological — the test feeds the value in and asserts it comes back; the to_report_data wiring is never exercised
evidence: Test helper: `let docs = list.length(pdf_prebake.documents_for(app_id))` / `let raw = pdf_report_data.extras_for(app_id, docs)` then the assertion `extras.docs_processed |> should.equal(list.length(pdf_prebake.documents_for(app_id)))`. The production call site `extras: Some(pdf_report_data.extras_for(p.application_id, list.length(documents_for(p.application_id))))` (server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:604) is only reached via `to_report_data`, which no test calls (grep confirms).
detail: The assertion compares the test's own input to itself, so it cannot fail: if to_report_data is ever changed to pass a wrong count (e.g. 0), the PDF's 'documents processed' stat silently diverges from the rendered document list with no red test.
recommended_fix: Exercise to_report_data (or payloads() through it) and assert each ReportData's extras documents_processed equals its snapshot document count.

title: Pin iterates a hardcoded applicant list parallel to payloads(); the extras fallback arm bakes a silently thin report for any unlisted id
evidence: Test: `const all_applicants: List(String) = ["a-aoife", "a-conor", "a-marta", "a-declan", "a-sara", "a-tom", "a-grainne", "a-liam"]` and `list.each(all_applicants, fn(app_id) {`. In server/src/demo/pdf_report_data.gleam:139 the dispatch ends with `_ -> fallback_parts()`, whose body returns `notes: json.object([])` and `recs: []` (lines 166-167). The bake iterates pdf_prebake.payloads() (8 ids today, matching), not the test's list.
detail: If a 9th applicant is added to payloads() but not to this test's const, its PDF bakes through fallback_parts with empty category notes and no recommendations — the exact 'scanty report' regression this fix eliminates — and every test stays green.
recommended_fix: Derive the tested id list from pdf_prebake.payloads() (already pub) instead of a parallel const, so any baked applicant is automatically pinned.
